description.text:
The first set of the Scarlet & Violet series and of the ninth generation, released on 31 March 2023 with 198 cards plus secret rares, made from the Japanese Scarlet ex and Violet ex of 20 January 2023. It brought back Pokémon ex, in lower case for the first time since the third generation, which give up two Prize cards when Knocked Out, and brought in Tera Pokémon ex, with a crystalline look, which cannot be damaged by attacks on the Bench. Koraidon ex and Miraidon ex lead it, with the Paldea first partners Sprigatito, Fuecoco and Quaxly.

The series changed the cards themselves: silver borders, new rarities such as illustration rares, a pack of one holo and two reverse holos, and Pokémon Tools as their own kind of Trainer, no longer Items. It was the first set with the G regulation mark.
